You purchase and then I build as quickly as possible. Preorders take about two weeks but rarely can take up to four. Every pedal is made by hand for YOU. /////////////////////////////////////////////// Designed for Garrett of WINDHAND to be a live replacement for his vintage LBM fuzz/distortion pedal. Added gain control, indicator light and true bypass switching as well as upgraded WIMA caps, Matamp style knobs and additional filtering for the 9v power supply. The external tone switch is now a PCB mounted internal switch to switch between "treble" and "bass" modes. This is not one of those annoying dip switches where you need to find a tool to switch it with, it's very easy to use and out of the way. UPDATE 11/23 Added a trim pot instead of the toggle switch like the original. The "dark" setting is Garett's preference (tone pot all the way to the bass side) LIMITED EDITION All Blackhawk fuzz pedals can be placed anywhere in your guitar chain. You never have to worry about buffers or active pickups getting in the way of your tone.
